items.q: What is the complexity of merge sort?
items.why: It's O(n log n). “O(n)” is the classic near-miss here; knowing why it's wrong is worth as much as knowing the right answer.

items.q: Which describes accessing an array element by index?
items.why: It's O(1). “O(log n)” is the classic near-miss here; knowing why it's wrong is worth as much as knowing the right answer.
The real figure is 10 value. The wrong options cluster deliberately close — anchor the exact number to one concrete fact so it can't drift.
